title: E18 traffic at Lysaker
author: Kjetil_r
location: E18 at Lysaker, Norway, toward Sandvika
license_statement: The author releases this own work into the public domain worldwide; where that is not possible, grants anyone use for any purpose without conditions unless required by law.
modifications: Source excerpt: 5.000 to 30.000 seconds (750 source frames at 30 fps).
Per-frame 2D similarity transform estimated from static-building feature matches to reduce handheld camera drift.
Fixed 64-pixel crop on each edge after stabilization; resized from 1152 x 592 to 960 x 494.
Ambient audio removed; H.264 MP4 encoded with yuv420p and faststart.
No generated vehicles, frame interpolation, timing changes or artificial vehicle motion.
limitations: Free-flow highway traffic, not a school dismissal or standing queue.
Stabilization reduces visible handheld drift but does not make image coordinates a calibrated distance or speed.
No human ground-truth annotations or detector accuracy claims; a short public-footage showcase only.
Opposing vehicle flows, perspective, and distant occlusion may fragment tracks.
